npcs.name: Sailor 2 pier 1
npcs.text: It's always a long hard day's work on these docks, I never get an early night.
npcs.repeat_text: Even though the harbour is a really safe place, it's still no reason to go wandering around at night if you don't have to

npcs.name: Sunbathing dude 1 night
npcs.text: ugh.. oooo.. hello? Good morning? oops it seems I fell asleep on the beach again... I shouldn't be out this late, thanks for waking me up. Take this as a thank you
npcs.repeat_text: I better head home soon, I accidentally do this all the time so my wife can probably guess what happened but she'll still be worried.

npcs.name: Sailor working on dock
npcs.text: I'm normally finished by now, but with the SS Anne arriving tomorrow there's still too much work to do.
npcs.repeat_text: It's going to be even busier than a usual day tomorrow. It'll definitely be a long day.

opponents.name: Firebreather_Darryl
opponents.meet_text: I've been breathing that much fire that I needed an ice cold bev to cool my mouth down, but I'm ready for a match if you want.
opponents.rematch_text: I'm fired up and ready for another match if you want.
opponents.rematch_win_text: I could teach you how to firebreath... but maybe you should teach me how to play cards better!
opponents.loss_text: That juice was just what I needed!

opponents.name: Firebreather_Kenneth
opponents.meet_text: I'm so used to hot drinks that it's weird to drink something nice and cold
opponents.rematch_text: If you want another match then let's goooooo
opponents.first_win_text: I have too many burns to battle well
opponents.rematch_win_text: I'll just stick to the firebreathing from now on, I'm good at that.

opponents.name: Psychic_Brienne
opponents.meet_text: I love the peace of the harbour at night, the sound of the waves in the dark are really relaxing
opponents.rematch_text: It's easier to meditate at night
opponents.first_win_text: I have to focus more. Take these cards to help you focus more too

opponents.name: Sailor_Bob
opponents.meet_text: I'm all done preparing for the arrival of the SS Anne so there's not much to do now until morning
opponents.rematch_text: There's still time before the SS Anne arrives
opponents.first_win_text: I should at least pretend to do some work on the dock
opponents.rematch_win_text: I won't have a lot of time to play when the ship docks
opponents.loss_text: All this spare time has given me a chance to practice

opponents.name: Jogger_Daniel
opponents.meet_text: I've been training for my marathon all day so I'm worn out, I've ran over 30km today alone.
opponents.first_win_text: I've ran far too much today I should have just rested.
opponents.rematch_text: I'm still taking a break before heading home.
opponents.rematch_win_text: I'm just going to focus on my running from now on
opponents.loss_text: I'm glad I decided to take a break, that's given me an extra push to carry on

opponents.name: Hiker_Matthew
opponents.meet_text: I've been hiking for hours and only just managed to reach the harbour and found everything is closed so now I have nothing to do for the evening.
opponents.first_win_text: I should have just called it a night...
opponents.rematch_text: I'll be back to hiking again tomorrow, I hike all day every day!
opponents.rematch_win_text: I could do with a long hike to get over this loss.

opponents.name: Bad_Dude_Paul
opponents.meet_text: Heh you want to try and beat me kid??
opponents.first_win_text: Damn... they're gonna kick me out of the cool guy biker gang for this
opponents.rematch_win_text: Now they're DEFINITELY going to kick me out of the cool guy biker gang...
